targets.title: Smile intensity in photographs predicts longevity.
targets.evidence_quote: Abel and Kruger (2010) found that the smile intensity of professional baseball players who were active in 1952, as coded from photographs, predicted these players’ longevity. In the current investigation, we sought to replicate this result and to extend the initial analyses.
targets.outcome_quote: In both samples and for all three indicators, we found that positive affectivity did not predict mortality once birth year was controlled as a covariate.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The stated original prediction was absent after controlling birth year, across indicators and samples.
